text: Opening bar: one knee straightens as the dancer extends one arm right and the other left, then lowers both hands before lifting them, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the arms fold and separate sideways, one reaching down-right while the other curls up-left over a bending knee; both sweep right with that knee releasing, then reverse left as the opposite knee bends and the leading hand returns right, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: the hands climb and exchange lateral directions, one curling upward over a bent knee before that knee straightens and its arm opens down-left, while the other reaches right and rises into an extension, with a smooth release. Next bar: both hands move right as the opposite arm tucks, then the leading hand drops left and unfolds; the tucked arm sweeps down-left, opens, and reverses right over a bend and release of its knee. Its second beat: that hand climbs through another knee pulse as the other travels right and down, then lowers left while the raised arm curls farther upward, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: as one hand rises, the dancer curls that arm leftward and releases it down while the opposite hand drops right, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the initial hand continues left as both hands descend, then the arms lengthen in succession, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both hands sweep up and left with the opposite arm extending farther, before that hand reverses right and curls upward alongside the other hand's lift, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the curled arm opens and its hand returns left, joined by the other hand as the knee beneath it straightens, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: the hands continue rising and separating, the initial arm extending farther left, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: as one knee straightens, the dancer curls the hand on that side up and left, then extends it down while the opposite arm folds and its hand sweeps right, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: the first hand rises rightward with a tighter curl as the other reaches left and drops, then both sweep left before the lower arm opens upward and the raised hand descends toward the right, with a drawn-out, heavy move. Bar close: both hands continue rightward with folding elbows and descending paths, the other hand leading farther right as the knees lengthen, with a lingering release. Next bar: the leading hand returns left into an extension and climbs while the opposite elbow tucks, then both hands rise with the leading arm drawing in and the other reaching out, with a brief hold. Its second beat: the leading arm opens downward and curls upward again as the opposite hand continues right and rises, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: one knee softens as the dancer sends both hands left, then lifts one hand into a curl while the other arm extends right and folds inward, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the folded hand rises farther before reversing right and dropping as its arm opens, while the opposite arm tucks and lowers, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both arms lengthen downward, the initial hand continuing right and then folding upward before opening again, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: that hand sweeps left as the opposite arm curls up and releases, then the initial arm gathers in once more, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: as one hand moves left and the other right, both rise, then reverse sideways with the second arm curling inward, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the first hand lifts farther left as its arm folds, while the other lowers and opens before rising again, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both hands descend, the first reaching left, before they lift together and the second sweeps left, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the first arm tucks and lowers alongside the other's drop, then extends right while the opposite elbow bends and releases; the first hand curls upward as the other rises, and both elbows fold. Its second beat: the hands sweep left and down, the first extending farther before both arms lengthen, then climb in succession, with the first folding as the other reaches higher. Phrase end: the first drops and unfolds while the other continues rising, and the first hand returns left as the opposite arm draws inward, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: the dancer performs a descending arm sweep: one hand lowers while the other reaches right and down, then both rise and separate sideways as the reaching arm folds, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: both hands drop with the folded arm opening and the other curling upward, then the first hand reverses up-right into another fold as the opposite arm extends left, with a drawn-out, heavy move. Bar close: the raised hand returns down-left, opens and curls back up-right while the lower hand continues downward, with a lingering release. Next bar: the curled hand drops and reaches left as its knee softens, then rises while that knee straightens; the other hand follows upward to the right and folds in, joined by a lengthening of the opposite arm, with a brief hold. Its second beat: both hands descend again, the extended arm curling higher before both elbows open and their knees soften in succession, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: one arm lengthens downward, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the other hand sweeps left and rises into a fold as the first knee straightens, then both hands climb right with that knee softening while the first elbow tucks, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: the raised arm extends down and left, followed by the other hand lowering toward the left; both knees bend as the latter hand reverses right and curls upward, with a smooth release. Next bar: both arms reach right before the first hand drops and the opposite knee straightens, with a crisp accent. Its second beat: the lowered hand continues down and right as the other moves left, then lifts and returns right while its corresponding knee bends and releases beneath an extending elbow, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: as one hand moves right, the dancer lengthens both arms, raises the other toward the left and drops the leading arm into a fold while its knee straightens, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the other arm opens, then curls upward as the leading knee bends; the hands sweep left before the raised arm tucks down and releases back to the right. Bar close: the other hand continues right with a deeper fold as the bent knee softens further, then both hands lower and sweep left, the leading arm extending before folding again, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the knees trade bend and release twice in succession while the hands rise, the other arm opening as the leading arm reaches left and lifts, followed by the opposite hand moving left. Its second beat: both hands descend and sweep right, the leading elbow curling inward as the other knee bends, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: the dancer sends one hand right and down as the opposite knee bends, then carries that hand left into a fold while the other arm lengthens upward, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the folded arm opens downward and both hands sweep right before the raised hand drops and returns left, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: that hand curls up toward the right, with its knee softening, then lowers while the other hand rises and its knee straightens, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: both hands move left as the first knee bends again, then the opposite arm tucks downward and both elbows release. Its second beat: the first hand lifts right against the other's continued descent, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: as one arm curls up and right, the dancer lowers and folds the other arm before both hands sweep left, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the first hand drops and extends while the opposite knee straightens, then both hands rise as that knee bends and releases; the second arm tucks and opens into a shared leftward sweep before the first hand climbs and the other sinks with a further fold. Bar close: both hands return right, the first arm lengthening downward as the other rises, then the hands reverse left and climb together with the first elbow curling inward, with a smooth release. Next bar: that hand reverses right as its knee softens, then returns left and lifts while the other arm folds left and drops, with a crisp accent. Its second beat: the raised hand dips again before rising once more as the opposite hand moves right and both knees bend, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: in opposition, one arm curls upward and moves right while the other hand lifts left, then both descend with the first elbow opening and the second folding, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the second hand reverses right as its knee bends, while the first arm curls up-left and the other lengthens down-left; the knees exchange their bend and release before the hands reverse sideways again. Bar close: both arms fold downward as the first knee softens, then the first arm opens and rises into a curl while the opposite hand sweeps right and down with an extended elbow, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the first knee straightens as its hand drops and the other climbs left, then the bent arm reaches right while the first knee bends and releases beneath another curling lift of that hand. Its second beat: the raised hand continues left as the other drops and extends, then both move right before the first lowers and the other curls upward. Phrase end: the first hand returns left and folds higher while the opposite arm tucks farther in, finishing with both hands rising and the first knee bending, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: as one hand lowers, the dancer lifts and folds the other arm left while the lower hand continues down; the raised hand then drops as its knee straightens, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the opposite hand travels right and curls upward as its knee bends and releases, then both hands climb with that arm tightening further. Bar close: both hands sweep left, the newly raised arm opening downward while the other folds up-right; the lower arm tucks as the opposite knee softens, and the hands separate again before the latter rises and extends, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the opposite arm lengthens down-left while the raised hand returns right, then curls up-left over a bending knee as the other hand climbs and both knees bend in succession, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: that curled hand falls right and unfolds while the other arm opens downward, then the lower hand rises right and reverses left as its knee sinks further. Phrase end: the opposite knee straightens beneath a rightward extension of the rising hand, which then descends while the other hand moves right and its knee releases, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: the dancer straightens one knee, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: the opposite hand sweeps left and down, then curls upward as the other hand rises and folds; both knees bend in succession while the sweeping arm reaches farther left and its knee releases. Bar close: both arms open downward, then curl upward as the first knee softens again and the other hand moves right, with a lingering release. Next bar: that knee extends before bending once more beneath a descending rightward reach of the same arm, while the opposite arm lengthens up and left and the other knee straightens, with a brief hold. Its second beat: the hands separate horizontally with the reaching arm folding, then that hand reverses left as the opposite arm tucks upward; the reaching side's knee bends and straightens while its arm opens, and the other elbow releases. Phrase end: the raised hand returns left and drops into a fold as the other knee softens and its own knee straightens, then that knee bends again while the lowered arm extends left and lifts, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: a paired arm lift begins with the dancer bending one knee and lifting both hands, then straightening that leg as the other hand reaches right, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the first hand drops left while the other arm folds down, followed by a descent of the first and a tuck of its elbow, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both hands sweep right as the first knee bends again, then rise before the hands return left with lengthening arms, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the first arm curls upward while the other hand lowers into a fold, then the raised hand drops left and the bent knee softens further, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: both hands reverse right, the first rising with a tighter elbow as the other arm opens downward, then the knees straighten in succession while the second hand returns left, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: as one hand moves right, the dancer straightens the opposite knee and sends that hand left, then reverses the hands outward before both rise, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the arm that began moving right folds inward and drops as its knee bends; both hands sweep left, the other elbow opening before both arms curl upward, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: the knees alternate softening and straightening while the hands separate sideways, with the initially rightward-moving hand returning left, with a smooth release. Next bar: both hands climb again as the knees continue to exchange bend and extension, then the hands drop and separate once more, the other arm folding through a brief lift and descent while the initial arm lengthens downward, with a crisp accent. Its second beat: that descending hand swings right and back left, then rises into a curl as the opposite knee bends and releases; it repeats its sideways sweep twice more, alternating open-and-folded pulses while the other knee softens and straightens again, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: to begin, the dancer sends one hand right and down with a bent elbow while the other travels left, then lowers and lengthens the moving arm as its knee straightens, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the opposite knee bends as the initial hand sweeps left, both elbows fold and the hands rise before the hands separate sideways, the initial hand continuing left and the other returning right, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both arms open downward as the initial knee softens, then they curl upward and sweep left before the initial arm extends farther left and the opposite hand descends, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the opposite elbow tucks again as the initial arm lengthens down and right, followed by a drop and extension of the other arm; both hands rise and move left, the opposite arm folding as the initial elbow opens, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: the initial hand drops and curls back up toward the right while the opposite hand rises and moves right, then reverses left as the initial side lengthens and the opposite knee straightens and bends again, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: as one hand rises and the other curls upward, the dancer folds the first arm left and releases it down while the opposite hand lifts, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the first hand reverses right with a bend and release of its elbow as the other lowers and opens; both hands then sweep left, the second rising before returning right as the first drops. Bar close: both arms extend and lift together, then the first reaches left and the second curls downward, finishing with the first hand dropping and the other sweeping left, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the first arm folds upward toward the right as the opposite knee softens, then extends back left while that leg straightens, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: the hands reverse sideways together, the first curling up and the other tucking left and lowering. Phrase end: the first knee bends and releases beneath another upward reach of its arm, ending with the opposite hand moving right and up, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: in opposition, the dancer lowers one hand while lifting the other, then sends the lowered arm left and down as both elbows fold, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the hands sweep right together before the initially raised hand drops, its arm extending, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: that hand continues down and left while the opposite knee bends, then the lower arm curls upward and carries its hand right, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: both arms lengthen as the lifted hand climbs farther and the other sweeps right, with a sharp snap, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: the dancer folds one arm while the other hand moves right and down, then reverses left as its elbow opens, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the folded arm lowers and extends toward the right while the opposite hand continues left and its knee bends, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: the lower hand rises into a curl as the other knee softens further, then both hands descend with the latter moving right and the former returning left, with a smooth release. Next bar: the arms lengthen apart before the first hand lifts, curls and drops again, with a crisp accent, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: leftward, the dancer extends one arm while lowering and opening the other; both hands sweep right, the leading hand dropping as its knee softens, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: the opposite knee bends farther while that leading hand rises left and curls back right, then lowers with a deeper fold as the other hand climbs, with a drawn-out, heavy move. Bar close: both knees straighten in succession as the hands descend, the leading arm reaching down-left while the opposite arm folds upward; the hands reverse sideways and rise together, then sweep right and lower with the elbows drawing inward, with a lingering release. Next bar: another left-to-right exchange brings the leading hand up-left and the other down-right, followed by a shared lift and a drop as both arms lengthen, with a brief hold. Its second beat: the leading hand returns right while the other travels left, then they separate again and the opposite hand rises as the leading arm extends left and drops; both hands move left before reversing right, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: in opposition, one hand travels left while the other moves right and rises into a curl, then both arms lengthen as the hands descend, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the initial hand sweeps up-right and curls inward, joined by the other arm drawing tighter as its hand rises left, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both hands lower and open, the initial arm sweeping left before they climb again, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the other hand reverses right and drops with a deeper tuck, while the initial arm folds and lifts; it then extends down-left as the opposite elbow opens and the initial knee softens, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: that hand climbs again as the other lowers and lengthens, followed by the initial arm reaching right and upward while the other hand rises and curls left, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: as one knee softens, the dancer lowers both hands and sends them right, then lifts the other hand while its knee straightens, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: the initial hand reverses left as both arms extend, then the other drops and sweeps left with a deeper reach, with a drawn-out, heavy move. Bar close: both hands rise before the other continues up and right, curling as the initial arm folds and the opposite knee bends again, with a lingering release. Next bar: that curled hand dips and rebounds upward, joined by the initial arm reaching higher; the other hand then travels left and down, with a brief hold, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: to begin, the dancer lowers and extends one arm while the other folds left and lifts, then sweeps both hands right with the extended hand rising and the bent arm opening, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the lifted hand returns left as the other knee softens and its arm curls upward, then the hands separate left and right before both arms fold and descend into a rightward sweep, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: both knees bend as the opposite hand drops, then the sweeping arm opens and lifts while the other rises left; the sweeping arm curls back down and left as its knee straightens, followed by the other hand dropping and extending, with a smooth release. Next bar: the sweeping arm reaches right while the opposite hand moves left and its knee bends, then both hands rise and return toward each other before descending with the sweeping arm folding and the other opening, with a crisp accent. Its second beat: the hands separate once more, the sweeping arm extending while the other curls upward, before the sweeping hand reverses up and right as the other lengthens downward, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: one knee softens beneath a rising hand that curls right, then lowers and extends as the opposite hand travels left, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the lower arm folds up-left and opens again while the other curls upward; both hands descend, the opening arm reaching left before reversing right, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: that hand lifts into a fold as its knee straightens, then drops and lengthens farther right while the other rises with a tucked elbow, with a smooth release. Next bar: the dancer repeats the lifting curl-and-release figure with the same hand, then sweeps it right, down and left with an extended arm as the opposite knee bends and releases. Its second beat: both hands rise, one folding leftward while the other moves right and descends, then the folded hand dips and rebounds into another curl, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: the dancer folds one arm upward, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: both knees straighten as the hands sweep left, with the other arm reaching up and right before both elbows open and the initial hand drops, with a drawn-out, heavy move. Bar close: the arms curl again as the other hand rises and the initial elbow releases; the other knee softens while the hands descend into lengthened arms and reverse their sideways paths. Next bar: both hands lift with folding elbows, then separate right and left before the initial hand returns right and curls higher, with a brief hold. Its second beat: that arm opens down-left as the other reaches up-right, then tucks and lifts back toward the right while its knee bends and straightens. Phrase end: the other hand dips and rebounds left into a curl as the initial arm extends down-left, ending with the bent knee releasing farther, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: one knee straightens as the dancer sends one hand left and lowers it while the other travels right, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the hands reverse inward, the descending arm curling upward before both sweep left; the other hand follows up-left and folds, then returns down-right as its knee softens, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: that knee releases beneath a rising, tucking hand that moves left, while the opposite arm curls upward and swings right. Next bar: the first hand climbs farther as the other continues right, then the raised hand drops left into an extension, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: both knees bend in succession beneath another rightward reach of the first hand, followed by the other hand's lift and descent as its knee straightens, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: at the outset, the dancer sends one hand right and the other left as both arms lengthen, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the right-moving arm curls upward while its opposite lowers and folds, then that lower arm reaches farther down before both hands descend and sweep left, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both arms tuck inward, the initially right-moving hand rising while the other dips again; the rising hand then extends downward alongside the other hand's lift, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the first hand reverses up and right into a fold as the opposite knee straightens, then both hands lower and the first arm opens while the other continues left, with a sharp snap, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: one hand travels left and down, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the other curls up and right as the knee beneath it bends, then both arms lengthen while that knee straightens and its hand lowers, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both hands sweep left, the newly lowered arm folding upward and continuing left before releasing downward; the opposite arm rises and tucks, then extends as its knee softens, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: that same knee deepens its bend as its hand drops, then releases while both hands rise with folded elbows and the opposite hand moves right. Its second beat: the initially lowered hand dips and rebounds into an extended lift to the left as the other knee bends, then returns right and down with a lengthening arm while the bent knee straightens. Phrase end: the opposite arm reaches higher as the lower hand continues right and climbs, followed by the other hand lifting farther right and folding inward, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: to begin, the dancer curls one arm upward as the other hand moves left and rises, then lowers both arms while the first elbow opens and its knee straightens, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the hands sweep right, the first arm curling before dropping as both knees bend; the other hand lifts left and returns right as both knees extend, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: the first hand sweeps left and climbs with a folding elbow while the opposite knee softens, then drops as that knee straightens and the other arm curls up to the left, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: both hands reverse right with the first elbow tucked and the second knee bending, then descend into an opening of both arms as the knees lengthen, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: the first arm reaches down-left while the other hand continues right and lowers with an opening elbow, followed by the first hand moving right, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: at the outset, one knee softens as the opposite hand rises and the initial hand drops, then that knee straightens while the initial arm curls upward, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: the other arm folds down-left as its knee bends and releases, while the initial hand sweeps right and back left with an opening elbow. Bar close: both hands climb before the initial arm tucks and lowers rightward over a deeper bend of its knee, while the opposite arm reaches up-left and both knees lengthen, with a lingering release. Next bar: the initial hand lifts right and drops as its knee sinks again; the other hand lowers and returns right, followed by another dip and lift of the initial hand over a renewed knee bend, with a brief hold. Its second beat: the opposite hand continues right and rises as its knee releases, then the initial arm extends down-right and curls upward while the other arm opens, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: one hand moves right, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the other arm folds and carries its hand right as the knee beneath it straightens, then both hands rise while the leading hand reverses left and its corresponding leg lengthens further, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both arms open, the leading hand descending before the other drops, and they sweep left with the latter elbow drawing in, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the lower arm tucks farther as the leading hand returns right, then lifts and curls inward while the other reaches right and down, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: the lifted arm extends again as the other hand returns left and rises, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: in opposition, the dancer sends one hand left and the other right as both knees soften in succession, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: the right-moving arm curls upward while the left reaches farther, then both hands descend with a release of the knee beneath the right-moving arm; that hand swings left and back right before rising with an unfolding elbow. Bar close: both hands lower and sweep left, the other arm lengthening as its knee straightens, before the leading hand drops again and both arms fold, with a lingering release. Next bar: the opposite knee bends and releases beneath a lift of the leading hand to the right, which then lowers into a reach as the other arm opens downward and its knee softens. Its second beat: the leading hand sweeps left while the other rises with a tucked elbow and straightens its knee, then the leading arm extends up and right as the other hand moves right and the leading knee bends, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: the dancer lifts both hands, one arm folding and then unfolding as the other hand drops and its knee softens, with a slow, sustained reach, riding the slow pulse. Second beat: the raised hand travels left while the opposite arm curls up and right, then both elbows open as that hand returns down-left over a lengthening knee, with a drawn-out, heavy move. Bar close: both arms tuck and sweep right, the previously raised arm opening before curling again as its knee bends; the opposite elbow follows with a deeper fold, with a lingering release. Next bar: the folded arms rise toward the left, the initial arm releasing downward and sweeping right as the other elbow opens, with a brief hold. Its second beat: that other hand swings left, then both arms curl upward and separate sideways, with the initial hand moving left and the opposite arm extending right, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: a rising-and-falling arm exchange begins as the dancer curls one hand up-right and lowers it, then raises both hands while that arm opens, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the other hand moves left and tucks inward as the first arm folds higher, before the raised hand drops left into a deeper curl, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: the lower hand rises with a bent elbow and sweeps right while the opposite hand descends, then the latter arm reaches down-left, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the hands separate horizontally, the lower one moving right as the other climbs and extends farther left; both then return right and rise together, the initially lifted arm opening outward, with a sharp snap, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: one knee softens as the dancer sends one hand left and lowers both hands, then lifts them while that knee straightens, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat. Second beat: the other arm reaches right and down before curling upward, joined by the first hand rising into a fold; the first knee bends as its hand moves right and the other continues climbing left, with a quick, crisp hit. Bar close: both arms lengthen downward, the first hand returning left while the opposite hand reverses right, then the first curls upward as the other drops and extends, with a fast, staccato attack. Next bar: the raised arm opens while the lower hand sweeps left and rises with a tuck, then the raised hand follows left and descends into an extension, with a sharp snap. Its second beat: the opposite hand swings right and down, then returns left as the first arm folds and carries its hand right, and the chest stays open toward the music.

Opening bar: the arms move in opposition: one hand lowers and lengthens while the other reaches right, then both sweep left with the first curling upward and the second folding down, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the raised arm extends farther as its knee softens, then the hands reverse right and left with the other elbow opening; the first hand drops and both rise as that knee straightens, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: both hands sweep right and descend into folded elbows as the same knee bends again, then return left while the opposite leg lengthens, with a smooth release. Next bar: the first arm opens and curls upward as its knee releases, then extends right while the other elbow tucks and its knee straightens; the first knee bends as both hands lower and its arm folds. Its second beat: that knee straightens as the first hand rises and reaches right against the other hand's leftward sweep, then its knee softening and the opposite leg extending. Phrase end: the first hand falls and rebounds up-right as the other continues left, with another bend of the first knee before the latter arm curls downward, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: as one hand sweeps right and down, the dancer lifts the other leftward with a bent elbow while the lower arm lengthens, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the lifted hand continues upward as the opposite knee straightens, then both hands descend with the original hand returning left and its arm folding, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: that arm reaches right before curling back toward the left, while the other hand rises into a fold and drops farther left, with a smooth release. Next bar: both arms open, the original hand sweeping right and rising into another tuck, before the other hand returns up and right and the original hand descends again, with a crisp accent, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: the arms move in opposition: one curls up-left as the other hand rises, then both sweep right and descend, with a clear, measured attack, on the steady pulse. Second beat: the second arm folds down-right while the first lengthens down-left, followed by another curling lift of the second hand toward the left, with a steady, controlled accent. Bar close: the first hand lowers into a deeper tuck as the second continues upward and its knee softens; the first arm extends farther left before both hands fall and the elbows release. Next bar: the first knee bends as its hand lifts right with a folding elbow, then both arms reach left and descend, with a crisp accent. Its second beat: both knees straighten and soften in succession as the first arm curls upward again, followed by the other arm gathering upward before they separate sideways, the first continuing up-left, and the body stays gathered and close to itself.

Opening bar: at the outset, one arm curls upward and right while the other extends down and left, with a rapid, sharp accent, in time with the driving beat.
